content: Human-labeling session — combat-prevent-retreat:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 56x40 arena. You are given 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) staged in the north corridor (x=6, y=12..15) or the south corridor (x=6, y=25..28) depending on seed. An eight-strong enemy block of 2 rocket soldiers and 6 rifles holds the centre at x=30, y=16..23 on Defend stance. North flank ground (y=5..10) and south flank ground (y=30..35) are clear. Score 8 kills, place at least 1 tank inside the disc at (43,20) radius 8, and keep at least 3 tanks alive, within 3500 ticks.
